violation_type.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §744.2507(6))
violation_type.short_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection, multiple walls had peeling paint, broken trim, and cracks on the surfaces.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection, multiple walls had peeling paint, broken trim, and cracks on the surfaces.
One of the urinals in the boys restroom did not flush.  Another urinal was observed leaking water across the boys restroom.
About nine ceiling tiles appear to have water damage. one of the nine ceiling tiles appear to have mold damage, and two of the nine appear to be hanging down from the ceiling.
One room that was being used to care for children had a crack in a wall, a hole in a wall, and a broken outlet cover hanging off of the wall leaving one wire exposed.
There is 2 inch hole in the wall of a classroom.
Observed several ceiling tiles with dips and brown stains.
